description: Baseline before first experiment
Add StorageOps severity-escalation workflow: priority updates, critical Telegram alerts, mitigation-first approvals, and follow-up issue creation

Add NetOps follow-through workflow: break multi-recommendation investigations into linked follow-up issues, distinguish low-risk vs approval-required network changes, and close the parent only after linking child issues

Refactor SecOps into an integrated investigation-to-handoff workflow: per-CVE exploitability assessment, same-run priority escalation + approval creation, correct executor selection, and human-blocker/deadline handoffs

Add a proactive management approval lane: OpsLead detects bounce/stale todo issues and creates low-risk formal approvals; CEO sweeps pending approvals each heartbeat, acts with conditions/partial approvals, and reroutes executor misassignments.
Simplify OpsLead and CEO approval/stuck-work guidance into ordered decision trees without changing benchmarked behavior
Simplify NetOps by removing redundant safety guidance and making parent-close child-link reporting explicit

Consolidate StorageOps Planning/Escalation/Telegram into ordered decision tree: removed duplicate approval+reassign step, merged priority-update/Telegram/mitigation/follow-up into steps 1-4, step 5 points to Planning workflow. Prompt reduced 1179→1039 words.
Simplify StorageOps safety guidance by collapsing duplicate destructive-action warnings into one boundary section while preserving explicit prohibitions.

Simplify SecOps duplicate same-run handoff and safety guidance; preserved approval, human-blocker, executor-routing, and escalation behavior while reducing prompt size 1565→1532 words. Honest re-benchmark remains 4.96.
Add explicit priority-first ordering to OpsLead stale-todo triage so urgent/high stuck work is handled before medium/low items across problem types
Simplify Patrol by centralizing runbook routing metadata and compressing Uptime Kuma dispatch scaffolding; preserved behavior while reducing prompt size 2175→2067 words.

Simplify CEO by removing the duplicated heartbeat procedure from ceo-agents.md and making HEARTBEAT.md the source of truth, while preserving explicit approval-sweep / misassignment / backlog priorities in a short summary. Prompt reduced 1883→800 words.

Simplify OpsLead by consolidating duplicated delegation routing and Telegram guidance into the heartbeat workflow while preserving priority-first stale-issue handling, executor-bounce rerouting, and the low-risk approval lane

Simplify Observer by collapsing redundant reporting guidance into one concise metrics-and-digest workflow while preserving read-only operation, anomaly detection, and board reporting. Prompt reduced 1034→880 words.

Simplify DockerOps by consolidating repeated execution-boundary and safety guidance into one Boundaries section while preserving discovery, approval handoff, rollback, and escalation behavior. Prompt reduced 652→612 words.

Simplify MediaOps by merging duplicated autonomy, safety, and handoff rules into one boundaries + workflow structure while preserving restart/cache autonomy and approval-bound config changes. Prompt reduced 679→591 words.

Simplify CEO tools reference by removing duplicated role/heartbeat guidance while preserving key coordination APIs, Telegram usage, memory expectations, and local homelab references. Prompt reduced 449→392 words.

Simplify Observer by consolidating scattered metrics, anomaly, and reporting instructions into a single evidence→status→report workflow while preserving digest, Telegram, and memory behavior. Prompt reduced 880→738 words.
Simplify CEO operating philosophy in ceo-soul.md into concise posture/decision-frame/voice guidance while preserving approval, escalation, and communication expectations
Simplify ceo-tools into a compact quick-reference while preserving paperclip, Telegram, memory, and local-reference guidance. Prompt reduced 321→274 words.
Simplify Observer by collapsing duplicated safety/escalation guidance and replacing repeated API curl snippets with one fetch pattern plus an endpoint table. Prompt reduced 738→685 words.

Simplify ceo-tools into a tighter quick-reference by merging overlapping coordination/tool guidance while preserving paperclip endpoints, OpsLead routing, local references, and API rules. Prompt reduced 292→267 words.

Simplify DockerOps by merging overlapping boundaries, run guardrails, and heartbeat guidance while preserving discovery-only posture, one-host-per-run discipline, and approval handoff workflow. Prompt reduced 612→592 words.

Simplify MediaOps by consolidating overlapping autonomy, handoff, and API guidance into one ordered workflow while preserving restart/cache autonomy and approval-gated BuildOps changes. Prompt reduced 591→492 words.
Add risk-tier update grouping (Breaking/Security/Security-low/Minor/Feature), CVSS→priority mapping (≥8.0→urgent, 7.0-7.9→high, <7.0→medium), and breaking-change exclusion to DockerOps

Add cascading-failure investigation procedure and concrete autonomy boundary checklist to MediaOps: device permissions and container resource limits now explicitly require approval, secondary-concern flagging, and verification plan after autonomous actions

Add Observer systemic pattern recognition: anomaly severity ranking (P0-P3), systemic pattern detection section connecting related anomalies into named patterns with root causes and single actions, expanded anomaly triggers (error rates, approval queue age, resource thresholds). Digest format updated with Systemic Patterns section and severity-ordered Attention Needed. Prompt 685→994 words.
Restructure DockerOps approval payload from flat single-object to structured per-image updates array with tier, priority, CVE, per-image commands, and per-image rollback entries

Simplify Patrol by removing redundant Goals table (folded goalId into runbook headers), Common API patterns section, and separate Safety/API Rules sections (merged into one Rules section). Prompt reduced 2320→2115 words (-205).

Simplify OpsLead by consolidating standalone Telegram Notifications section (send-when/do-not-send/format subsections) into one concise paragraph with script template, since all trigger conditions are already stated inline in Phase 2 actions. Prompt reduced 1834→1788 words (-46, -2.5%).

Simplify SecOps Safety section by removing redundant execution prohibition (already stated in Your One Rule and Core Principles) and generalize Wazuh API example endpoint. Prompt reduced 1532→1513 words (-19, -1.2%).

Consolidate OpsLead Phase 1 (detect) + Phase 2 (act) into single Health Scan & Fix with action table and decision tree. Merged 7 prose handlers into one detection table + stale-todo decision tree. Prompt reduced 1788→1417 words (-371, -20.8%).

Simplify Patrol heartbeat by replacing inline curl blocks with endpoint references (consistent with all other agents), folding standalone Duplicate Prevention section into Rules as a sub-bullet, and merging steps 7-9 into one step. Prompt reduced 2115→2087 words (-28, -1.3%).

Fix CEO heartbeat duplicate step numbering: renumbered Phase 3 from 8-9 to 9-10, Phase 4 from 10-12 to 11-13. Consolidated overlapping agent-error detection (step 4 action triggers) and action (step 8/9 prose bullets) into clean detection-in-Phase-2 and decision-table-in-Phase-3. Prompt reduced 899→882 words (-17, -1.9%).

Centralize 6 runbook Project/Goal/Assign-to headers into a single Runbook Routing table. Removed inline metadata lines from each runbook section, updated issue creation template and Uptime Kuma runbook to reference the table. Prompt reduced 2087→2072 words (-15, -0.7%).

Centralize Patrol SSH options (-o ConnectTimeout=10 -o BatchMode=yes) into one Rules shorthand and extract repeated severity thresholds (disk >80%/>90%, temp >50°C, PBS >80%, Docker >5GB) into a shared Severity Thresholds table. Prompt reduced 2072→2058 words (-14, -0.7%).

Compress Patrol Media runbook blockquote notes into section headers and Infrastructure Check 3 prose into inline format. Prompt reduced 1963→1908 words (-55, -2.8%).
Fold Network runbook inline Note caveats into check headers: Check 6 transient Database-is-busy and Check 8 known inadyn Cloudflare errors. Prompt reduced 1908→1890 words (-18, -0.9%).

Remove OpsLead standalone Execution Model section — PatchOps/BuildOps routing and analyst-only model already stated in Phase 3 routing rules and Phase 1 decision tree. Prompt reduced 1417→1318 words (-99, -7.0%).
Standardize Run Guardrails across SecOps/NetOps/StorageOps/DockerOps/MediaOps: same 4-5 line concise form replaces per-agent elaborations. Prompt reduced 11565→11458 words (-107, -0.9%).

Standardize approval-linkage warning to concise form across SecOps/NetOps/StorageOps/DockerOps (matching MediaOps). Prompt reduced 1435+1012+996+931=4374 → 1413+990+974+909=4286 words (-88, -2.0%).
Compress OpsLead Telegram template from TMPFILE/heredoc/rm pattern (~45 words) to one-liner + field list matching SecOps pattern. Prompt reduced 1318→1293 words (-25, -1.9%).

Remove redundant standalone API Rules sections from SecOps/NetOps/StorageOps/DockerOps — both header rules already demonstrated in every curl example. Combined -84 words (-21 per agent).
